buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Technical Bid Conditions 1.The tenderer must submit a Bank Draft of ₹3,00,000 (Rupees Three Lakh only) along with the tender as an e arnest money deposit, drawn in favour of the District Social Welfare Officer, Pakur. The EMD shall not be acce pted through any other mode. Tenders submitted through any other mode of payment shall be treated as rejected. 2. Biddrs must be submit the GST registration certificate issued in the State of Jharkhand along with the tende

r. The tenderer must also attach self-attested copies of the establishment's latest GST returns (GST Forms GS TR-1 and GSTR-3B, as applicable, whether quarterly or monthly).In addition, a self-attested certificate must b e submitted establishing that the tenderer's aggregate taxable income for the preceding three financial years exceeds ₹70 lakh. 3. If the tenderer is a Private Limited or Public Limited Company, self-attested copies of the Company's Memo randum of Association (MoA) and Articles of Association (AoA) must be attached. 4. Biddrs must be submit the Self-attested copies of the audited financial statements and the Auditor's Report s for the preceding three financial years, namely 2023–24, 2024–25 and 2025–26, must be attached. J.P.T. reg istration and J.P.T TAX for the financial years 2023–24, 2024–25 and 2025–26 must also be attached. 5. Biddrs must be submit the Self-attested copies of the Income Tax Returns filed for the preceding three fina ncial years, namely 2023–24, 2024–25 and 2025–26, must be attached. 6. Biddrs must be submit the Trade Licence of the establishment, Registration certificate issued by the Labour Department,NSIC registration certificate for the relevant materials. 7. Biddrs must be submit the PAN, TAN and ISO Certification 9001:2015 certificate accredited by NABCB, relating to the relevant material. 8. Biddrs must be submit the work orders and work completion certificates demonstrating that, in each of the preceding two financial years, the tenderer has received and completed a single work order worth at least ₹2 crore for the supply of winter uniforms, including hoodies, pyjamas and sweaters, in any district of Jharkhand State. 9. Biddrs must be submit the A certificate issued by a Chartered Accountant (CA) confirming that the establishment has a net worth of at least ₹1.5 crore (Rupees One Crore Fifty Lakh only) must be attached and should be positive. 10. Biddrs must be submit the a certificate issued by a Chartered Accountant (CA), bearing a UDIN (Unique D ocument Identification Number), confirming an annual turnover of ₹2 crore for each of the preceding three fin ancial years. 11. Laboratory Test Report The tenderer must submit the original laboratory test report for the clothing, issued by a laboratory accredite d by NABL. The report must conform to the specifications and other conditions mentioned in the tender. The r elevant test tag must also be attached to the garment. 12. Weight and Washing QualityEach garment must weigh 225 grams or more. After washing, the garment m ust not develop bubbles or blister-like defects. 13. Submission of Winter Garment SamplesThe tenderer must submit samples of winter garments for the follo wing age groups at the time of opening of the tender, before the Tender Committee: · Age group 3–4 years. · Age group 4–5 years. · Age group 5–6 years. The successful tenderer must subsequently submit six pieces of samples for the above age groups before the Purchase Committee. These samples will be made available to the concerned projects as reference samples. 14. Character Certificate-A copy of the character certificate issued by the Deputy Commissioner must be attac hed. 15. Affidavit Regarding Blacklisting and Investigations-The tenderer must submit the original affidavit declarin g that the establishment/agency has not been blacklisted and is free from all allegations and investigations. 16. Exemption from EMD for MSME/Udyam-Registered Suppliers-Suppliers registered under MSME/Udyam shal l be exempted from payment of the earnest money deposit, subject to submission of the relevant MSME/Udya m registration status report issued by the District Industries Centre for the relevant materials. 17. Submission of Samples -It is mandatory to submit samples along with the tender. 18. Non-Conforming Supply-If the supplied goods do not conform to the submitted samples or the tender cond

itions, appropriate legal action shall be taken against the supplier, and the supplier may be blacklisted. 19. Right to Accept or Reject Tenders-The Purchase Committee reserves the right to accept a tender either pa rtially or completely, or to cancel any tender without assigning any reason. Important: Failure to submit any of the above-mentioned documents may result in rejection or cancellation of the tenderer's bid. B. Financial Bid Conditions 1. Opening of Financial Bids- The financial bids of only those tenderers who qualify in the technical bid evaluat ion shall be opened. 2. Marking of the Financial Bid Envelope-The envelope containing the financial bid must be clearly marked “FI NANCIAL BID” on the outside. 3. Maximum Rate-The maximum permissible rate for the material shall be ₹200 per piece (Rupees Two Hundr ed only), inclusive of all applicable taxes. 4. Rate Negotiation-The District Purchase Committee reserves the right to negotiate the quoted rates. 5. Conditional Tenders-Conditional tenders shall not be accepted. 6. Basis of Tender Award-The tender shall primarily be awarded on the basis of the quality and price of the wi nter garments. The tenderer must clearly indicate the required specifications of the proposed winter garments (Winter Unifor m Hoodie) in the submitted sample. 7. Inclusive Rates-The quoted rates must include transportation, handling and all applicable taxes. The quoted rates shall remain valid until completion of the procurement and supply process. 8. Earnest Money Deposit-The tenderer must submit a Bank Draft of ₹3,00,000 (Rupees Three Lakh only) alon g with the tender, drawn in favour of the District Social Welfare Officer, Pakur.Tenders received without the ea rnest money deposit shall not be considered. 9. Forfeiture of EMD-If, after submission of the financial bid, a tenderer withdraws the tender, or if the successf ul tenderer fails to deposit the Performance Security within the stipulated period after approval, the earnest m oney deposit shall be forfeited. C. Other Terms and Conditions 1. Technical Specifications of the Winter Garment (Hoodie) Sl. Particulars Requirement Rate 1. Sweater Quality Unisex 2. Colour Maroon Material (Blend Com 3. Acrylic-100%( +2%) position) 4. Yarn High Bulk Yarn 5. Neck Type Hoodie

6. Sleeve Full Regular Sleeve The rate must not exceed ₹200 per h 7. Weight 225 gm & above oodie, inclusive of GST. Shrinkage or 8. elongation on Washi 4% or Better ng (Max) Colour Fastness to Li 9. 4% or Better ght Change in colour 3 or Colour Fastness to 10. Better, stain on Adajac Washing ent Fabric 3 or Better Logo of Jharkhand G Logo of Jharkhand Gov 11 overnment (in Left ernment side) Maximum price: The rate must not exceed ₹200 per hoodie, inclusive of GST. Note: The original document states “4% or Better” for colour fastness to light. Since colour fastness is normall y expressed as a grade rather than a percentage, “Grade 4 or better” is used here as the likely intended mea ning. This should be confirmed with the tendering authority. 2. Basis of Tender Award The tender shall be awarded primarily on the basis of quality and price. 3. Blacklisted Establishments and Submission of False Documents If a tenderer whose establishment has been blacklisted by any other district or department submits a tender by creating a new establishment in another person's name, immediate legal action, including arrest where ap plicable, shall be taken against the concerned person. If false or misleading information or documents are submitted in connection with the tender, the tender applic ation shall be cancelled. 4. Supply to the Concerned Projects The selected supplier shall supply the materials to the concerned Child Development Project Offices in the dis trict in accordance with the approved samples and work order. 5. No Advance Payment No advance payment of any kind shall be made to the supplier. 6. Quality, Defects and Delivery Period- The supplied materials must be of good quality. If any defect is found in the supplied garments within one year, the supplier shall be entirely responsible for t

he defect. No additional payment shall be made to the supplier in this regard. The supplier must ensure 100% supply of the garments within 30 days. The required quantity of sweaters may be increased or decreased according to actual requirements. 7. Execution of Agreement- The selected/approved tenderer shall execute an agreement with the Dis trict Social Welfare Officer, Pakur. 8. Quality Verification and Payment-Only high-quality materials shall be accepted. After supplying the materials, the supplier must submit the following documents, duly certified by the concern ed Child Development Project Officer: · Proof of stock entry in the stock register, in the prescribed format. · Quality certificate confirming that the materials conform to the prescribed standards. · Supporting records/documents relating to the supply. Payment shall be made only after the required documents have been submitted and the prescribed verificatio n formalities have been completed. 9. No Advance Payment for Supplies-No advance payment shall be made for the materials to be supplied. 10. Compliance with Government Rules Strict compliance with all government-prescribed rules and regulations relating to the tender is mandatory.In the event of any deviation, the Purchase Committee shall be competent to take an appropriate decision. .
